Hi Alice (and Tom),

Thanks for the questions — Jordan from Redwood security here. Overview answers below and notes on evidence we can provide. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through anything.

1) SOC 2
- Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II examination in Q4 2025. We maintain ongoing monitoring and annual re-examination.
- We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA. Redaction will remove customer-identifiable details.
- Attachment (to follow under NDA): SOC2_Type_II_redacted.pdf

2) GDPR / Data residency
- We support GDPR compliance: we offer data processing addenda (DPA) and regional hosting options (US/EU). For EU data residency we can route inference and logs to EU regions per your account configuration.

3) HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads on our Private deployment offering and via a BAA for dedicated/customers. If you plan to process PHI on hosted API, we can provide a BAA for review and signature (legal typically takes 7–10 business days).

4) Incident Response & Breach Notification
- IR Process: We maintain a documented Incident Response Plan (IR_Plan_v3.2.pdf).
- Triage & Acknowledgement: Security incidents reported to security@redwoodinference.com are acknowledged within 1 hour during business hours; outside business hours we have on-call rotation with a 4-hour acknowledgement target.
- Investigation & Containment: We aim to complete initial impact assessment within 24–48 hours depending on scope.
- Customer Notification: We commit to notifying affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a breach that impacts customer data or system integrity; contractual SLA language can be included in the DPA/contract.
- Escalation path: Primary contact: incident_response@redwoodinference.com. For urgent matters: Jordan Blake (security lead) — +1 (415) 555-0142.

5) BCP / DR Evidence
- RTO/RPO: Our platform targets an RTO of 4 hours for critical services and RPO of under 1 hour for KV cache failover scenarios; exact numbers vary by deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated).
- Last DR test: Full tabletop + partial failover executed 2026-11-02. We have an internal DR_Test_Report_2026-11-02.pdf summarizing objectives and outcomes.

6) Evidence delivery and process
- For SOC2 and IR/DR documents we require a signed NDA or an existing contractual confidentiality clause. We can accept a standard vendor NDA (DocuSign link below) or we can exchange via a mutual NDA.
- Once NDA is executed we will: (a) upload redacted SOC2 Type II PDF, (b) share IR_Plan_v3.2.pdf, (c) provide DR_Test_Report_2026-11-02.pdf and a short summary.

DocuSign NDA: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/FT-4821-NDA
SOC2 drive link (post-NDA): https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2/SOC2_Type_II_redacted.pdf
IR/DR drive link (post-NDA): https://drive.google.com/redwood/ir/IR_Plan_v3.2.pdf

If you want to speed this, Ben can share our standard mutual NDA. If you have an internal procurement portal we can also upload the docs there.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
